people.brief: 둥근 코와 회색 콧수염. 방충망을 뒤로 걷은 양봉가.

people.name: 장터 운송 담당자
people.face: Korean woman about 39; long broad rectangular face, wide-set low straight eyes, short curved nose, strong chin, thin mouth, black hair braided tightly at nape.
people.costume: Dull blue long work shirt with rolled sleeves, ochre waist belt with a short coiled rope, charcoal pants, walking boots. One gloved hand lightly holds rope at belt, other open toward side.
people.brief: 긴 사각 얼굴과 단단한 턱. 수레 행렬의 운송 담당자.

people.name: 전단을 모은 여자
people.face: Korean woman about 51; pear-shaped face, narrow brow, broad strong lower cheeks, upturned small nose, deep narrow eyes, graying short curls close to head.
people.costume: Washed gray-green worker jacket over muted mauve blouse, dark plain trousers, old loafers. Holds folded blank papers under one arm, one finger points downward as if disputing a detail.
people.brief: 아래가 넓은 얼굴과 들린 코. 전단을 모아 대조하는 여자.

people.name: 젊은 뱃사람
people.face: Korean man about 25; small rectangular face, high broad cheekbones, narrow long nose, bright wide eyes, thick lower lip, short tousled black curls.
people.costume: Dull blue waterproof jacket with rolled cuffs, tan loose trousers, black rubber ankle boots. One tied waterproof package at hip held in hand, other hand lifted in greeting.
people.brief: 작은 사각 얼굴과 짧은 곱슬머리. 방수 꾸러미를 전하는 뱃사람.

people.name: 폐차장 형
people.face: Korean adult man about 45, very stocky with a short thick neck, a pear-shaped face and noticeably heavy soft lower cheeks, narrow sloping forehead, tiny high-set widely-spaced eyes, an exceptionally broad flat nose bridge and large round nose tip, round blunt chin, thin upper lip and fuller lower lip. Smooth CLEAN SHAVEN cheeks and upper lip, no goatee, no moustache, no beard. Large bald crown with a thin horseshoe of short straight black hair only around sides and back. The round fleshy face must NOT resemble a square-jawed buzzcut fighter or any canonical character.
people.costume: Faded gray mechanic coveralls sleeves tied at waist, dull blue shirt, dark work boots. One hand carries a small alternator part low, other on hip.
people.brief: 둥글고 살집 있는 볼, 큰 코끝, 벗겨진 정수리. 짧고 굵은 체격의 폐차장 형.

people.name: 폐차장 동생
people.face: Korean man about 30; long narrow face, same family broad protruding ears but narrow chin and longer rounded nose, higher thin eyebrows, clean-shaven, black straight hair longer at front. Tall lanky build.
people.costume: Dull brown mechanic coveralls fully worn, gray undershirt, old work boots. Holds a plain folded rag in both hands, slight tilted skeptical head. No machinery beyond rag.
people.brief: 형과 귀는 닮았지만 긴 얼굴과 마른 체형. 폐차장 동생.

people.name: 호송대 운전사
people.face: Korean man about 45; very broad oval face, close-set hooded eyes, crooked thick nose, square chin, full thinly stubbled cheeks, nearly bald with short dark hair at sides.
people.costume: Faded navy padded trucker vest over dark maroon sweatshirt, gray loose trousers and plain work shoes. One hand holding a dented plain thermos low, other pocketed.
people.brief: 넓은 타원 얼굴과 굵게 휜 코. 밤 호송대의 운전사.

people.name: 순임
people.face: Korean elderly woman about 75; compact wiry short body, small square face, very deep-set sharp eyes, high narrow nose, thin determined mouth, straight white hair combed tight into small bun.
people.costume: Distinct MUSTARD roadwork safety vest over faded gray shirt, wide navy trousers, black rubber shoes. One gloved hand raised palm out in a stop gesture, other holds short paint brush lowered. Only small yellow paint on glove.
people.brief: 작고 각진 얼굴과 날카로운 눈매. 겨자색 조끼의 길 수선공.

people.name: 대양
people.face: Korean elderly male mechanic about 78; broad heavy face, prominent low rounded nose, thick pale eyebrows, bright narrow eyes, big ears, short thick white hair combed backward, clean-shaven.
people.costume: Faded dark teal mechanic jacket over brown shirt, plain gray trousers, old rubber work shoes. Sleeves rolled with robust forearms, hands resting at hips as if assessing a vehicle. No coffee pot, no motorbike.
people.brief: 큰 귀와 낮고 둥근 코. 달구지를 기억하는 정비공 대양.
